name: create_brake_pedal
description: Create a brake-pedal lattice bracket (pivot + clevis rings + footpad) with web_type solid|xtruss|fcc lattice fill, export STEP/STL, open FreeCAD GUI. Material defaults to Al 6061-T6.

web_type.description: Web fill: solid, 2.5D X-truss, or fcc lattice
web_type.title: Web Type

strut_radius_mm.description: X-truss strut thickness mm (or FCC strut radius), 1-5
strut_radius_mm.title: Strut Radius Mm

material.description: Material id or alias (al6061t6 default; also al7075t6, ti6al4v, pa12, steel; 'ti', '7075', 'nylon' accepted)
material.title: Material

name: create_uav_arm
description: Create the flagship UAV arm (root clamp boss + tapered arm + tip motor-mount ring), web_type solid|xtruss (chord rails + exposed X-truss web), export STEP/STL, open FreeCAD GUI. Demo load case: 120 N tip thrust at the motor ring. Material defaults to Al 6061-T6.

web_type.description: Arm fill: solid, or chord rails + exposed X-truss web
web_type.title: Web Type

material.description: Material id or alias (al6061t6 default; also al7075t6, ti6al4v, pa12, steel)
material.title: Material

name: get_lattice_metrics
description: Return relative density, volumes, and mass estimate for the current brake-pedal geometry.

name: compare_brake_pedal_variants
description: Compare solid vs X-truss vs FCC brake-pedal mass, relative density, max von Mises, pad deflection; recommend lightest with SF>=1.5 against the program material's yield.

name: compare_materials
description: F09 material comparison for a part: rows for every table material (Al 6061-T6, Al 7075-T6, Ti-6Al-4V, PA12, Steel-Generic) with mass, max von Mises, safety factor vs that material's yield, and scaled deflection, ranked by lightest at SF>=1.5. Scales the best available base run (session -> run history -> precomputed; labeled per row) linear-elastically; PA12 deflection is flagged not verified. Every row carries citation sources.

name: get_design_program
description: Return the persisted design program (source of truth) for a part: editable params, read-only fixed constants, revision number, and params hash. Defaults to the active part; with no active part, lists the programs on disk.

name: update_design_program
description: Edit the design program and rebuild the part in one step (e.g. 'set cell size to 12' without recreating): merges changes over current params, range-preflights (hard reject, never clamps), rebuilds geometry, commits the new revision on success. A failed rebuild preserves the accepted revision; a no-op change does not rebuild or bump the revision.

changes.description: object of param -> value, e.g. {"cell_size_mm": 12}; editable: web_type, cell_size_mm [5,40], strut_radius_mm [1,5], material (al6061t6|al7075t6|ti6al4v|pa12|steel; aliases like 'ti', '7075', 'nylon' accepted) for lattice parts; arm_length_mm [120,320], cell_size_mm [6,30], strut_radius_mm [1.5,4] for the uav_arm; or length_mm [10,500], width_mm [2,100], height_mm [1,50], material for the cantilever
changes.title: Changes

dry_run.description: bool, default false — preflight + hash preview only, no rebuild
dry_run.title: Dry Run

name: create_cantilever
description: Create a rectangular cantilever beam (mm), export STEP/STL, and open the model in the FreeCAD GUI. Material defaults to Steel-Generic.

material.description: Material id or alias (steel default; also al6061t6, al7075t6, ti6al4v, pa12)
material.title: Material

name: apply_load_and_solve
description: Apply load (N), mesh with Gmsh, solve with CalculiX inside FreeCAD (brake-pedal footpad, UAV-arm motor ring, or cantilever tip), save results, open GUI. Requires create_brake_pedal, create_uav_arm, or create_cantilever first.

force_n.description: Load in newtons (default 500 pedal / 20000 mount / 100 cantilever)
force_n.title: Force N

mesh_max_size_mm.description: Coarse mesh size mm (default 5 pedal / 4 mount / 2.5 cantilever)
mesh_max_size_mm.title: Mesh Max Size Mm

name: get_max_von_mises
description: Return max von Mises stress (MPa) from the latest solve.

name: query_results
description: Query the stored per-run solve history: latest run in full (mass, max von Mises + its location, deflection, mesh size, method flag, expected-vs-actual divergence) plus a compact list of recent runs. 'Where is stress concentrated' = max_vm_location_mm of the latest run.

run_id.description: Optional run id from a previous solve (returns that run only)
run_id.title: Run Id

last_n.description: How many recent runs to list
last_n.title: Last N

name: run_convergence_study
description: Mesh convergence study for the active part: 2-3 live CalculiX solves at refining mesh sizes (default ladder = 1.0x/0.7x/0.5x of the part default, e.g. pedal 5/3.5/2.5 mm), then a recommended mesh size = the coarsest mesh within 5% of the finest max von Mises. Synchronous and headless; expect roughly the cost of 2-3 apply_load_and_solve calls. Refuses setups without live solves (fcc pedal precomputed KPIs, FreeCAD absent).

mesh_sizes_mm.description: Optional explicit mesh sizes mm (2-4 distinct entries, coarse->fine); default ladder = 1.0x/0.7x/0.5x of the part default
mesh_sizes_mm.title: Mesh Sizes Mm

name: open_in_freecad
description: Launch FreeCAD GUI with the latest CAD/FEM document.
